The '''Sif-Alula system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Trestis sector/Legends|Trestis sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

The [[Sif-Alulan process]] was likely designed in this system.
